marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 to 25 knots diminishing to northwest 15 to 20
this morning then becoming northwest 20 early this evening. Wind diminishing to
northwest 15 late this evening and to light late overnight. Wind increasing to
west 10 to 15 Thursday afternoon and to west 20 Thursday evening. Showers changing to flurries this evening and ending near
midnight. Showers Thursday evening. Fog patches forming late this morning and
dissipating early this evening. <br/>
